summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, with hands-on experience building AI-assisted distributed systems in Python and C++. Designed a three-layer WebSocket architecture (Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO server, Jetson controller) deployed as a systemd Linux service, and integrated LLM-based intent classification (Gemini) with optimized ML inference (PyTorch, TensorRT). Comfortable across the full software development lifecycle, from OOP system design to Git-based collaboration.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API; added domain-specific special tokens and resized decoder embedding layer accordingly.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system over a three-layer distributed pipeline: Flutter mobile client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller linked by a unified WebSocket fabric.
Integrated faster-whisper STT, Gemini intent classification, and TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) for visual servoing.

Deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a systemd service (Type=simple, auto-restart with backoff, non-root user/group isolation, environment-file-based config) with static IP networking for reliable multi-device WebSocket registration.

projects.name: Frame Simulator — Desktop 3D Coordinate-Frame Visualizer
bullets: Built a PySide6/Qt desktop GUI with an OpenGL-backed VisPy 3D viewport to visualize coordinate-frame hierarchies and SE(3) poses in real time.
Decoupled data model, math, visuals, and UI into separate modules with a mix-in pattern centralizing transform-apply, matrix-refresh, and animation logic.
